summary: Single target ep 14 promoted to an exact full record: it adapts chapters 36, 38, 39 (volume 5), skipping ch 37. The skip is confirmed on both sides of the fandom reverse map (chs 36/38/39 each credit Episode 14; ch 37's infobox says anime episode = None) and independently by Wikipedia's chapter list, where ch 37 is titled exactly 'Idiots Can't Win!' (Baka ja Katenai no yo!) — the same title as the BD OVA — and ep 14's END is title-matched (ep 14 'You Look Just Like Him' / Sokkuridane vs ch 39 'They're So Alike'). The OVA sits order-only: fandom treats it as episode 13.5 (between eps 13 and 14, where ch 37 falls), but it is not part of the 75-episode TV run — it was bundled with manga volume 25, released 2013-12-04 (AniList 19669, MAL 19669), long after S1 aired. Continue point set to 37 to acknowledge the skip.

anchors.note: Fandom ep page 'manga chapters = 36, 38 and 39'; chapter reverse maps agree (36/38/39 -> Ep 14, ch 37 -> None); Wikipedia chapter list puts 36-39 in v5 (35-43) and title-matches END (ch 39 'They're So Alike' = ep 14 'Sokkuridane'); brackets consistent with stored ep13->35 and ep15 = 40-42.
